name: host
label: URL
help: Include the port if PRTG does not use the default one, and the path if PRTG sits behind a reverse proxy.

pattern.message: Enter the scheme and host, e.g. https://prtg.example.com — no query string

name: apiToken
label: API key
help: A PRTG API key with **Read access**, created under **Setup → Account Settings → API Keys** using the **Scripting** token type. PRTG only shows the key once, so copy it when you create it.
